description: Java class defining MonkeyActivityEvent, which simulates activity events in Android's Monkey testing framework, including methods for creating intents and starting activities with specific parameters.

classes.name: MonkeyActivityEvent
classes.description: Represents an activity event in the Android Monkey testing framework, capable of launching activities with specific intents and parameters.

methods.name: getEvent
methods.description: Creates an Intent for the activity, adding categories and flags based on internal state.

methods.name: injectEvent
methods.description: Injects the activity event by starting the activity via IActivityManager, handling exceptions and verbose logging.

methods.name: getPackageName
methods.description: Retrieves the package name of the current process based on UID, used for permission checks.
